components.css: .ds-glass-trigger{font:15px "Inter Variable",sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;min-height:48px;max-width:100%;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.83);border:1px solid rgba(98,85,99,.16);box-shadow:none;backdrop-filter:blur(var(--glass-blur,24px)) saturate(140%);color:#29262c;cursor:pointer;transition:background 150ms ease,box-shadow 150ms ease}.ds-glass-trigger:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.95)}.ds-glass-trigger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-color,#404047);outline-offset:3px}.ds-glass-menu{font-family:"Inter Variable",sans-serif;margin-top:8px;max-width:400px;padding:7px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(252,251,253,.91);backdrop-filter:blur(var(--glass-blur,24px)) saturate(160%);border:1px solid #ffffffd9;box-shadow:0 18px 48px #24152425,inset 0 1px 0 #fff;color:#28242a}.ds-glass-option{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-height:50px;padding:13px 17px;border-radius:13px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.45}.ds-glass-option:hover,.ds-glass-option:focus-visible{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus-color,#404047) 11%,white);outline:none}.ds-glass-option[aria-selected=true]{font-weight:550}

narrative.overview:
The October 22 workspace uses a full-bleed warm off-white conversation, a quiet neutral navigation rail, subdued initials avatars, and an adjustable Graphite default action accent. A single conversation toolbar and a centered two-row composer establish hierarchy. Open GrokBot keeps its own name and mark. Glass remains available for menus and dialogs; conversation text stays the primary visual anchor.

The frontmatter and the October 22 refresh below describe the current composition. Earlier dated sections are preserved as implementation history; the October 22 values supersede conflicting frame, palette, bubble, sidebar, and composer descriptions. Existing product capability and verification limits remain separate from visual evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed off-white thread and compact neutral rail with Open GrokBot branding.
Neutral message bubbles, a two-row white composer, and a restrained heading.
Adjustable action accent, roster density, type size and motion preferences.
Keyboard-operable selects and dialogs with persistent actions and visible recovery states.
dos: Do preserve the light Grok identity while making glass controls generous and readable.
Do keep blur and motion user-adjustable and keyboard states visible.
Do keep dialog actions reachable while fields scroll.
Do use explicit state text for goals, queued work, blocked runs, and deliveries.
Do keep private credentials masked and separate from connection-status claims.
donts: Don't claim new goals, channels, preferences, or plugin controls are live verified from source tests alone.
Don't infer private-account OAuth access from a webhook or MCP URL.
Don't replace task content with invented successful examples.
Don't force every surface into a floating glass card.
Don't claim screenshot pixel fidelity or universal provider/tool readiness.
